name: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers and Brews
notes: DoorDash schema.org Menu JSON-LD for the exact Escondido branch (200 East Via Rancho Parkway matches work-list address). Own site (redrobin.com/menu) is a client-rendered SPA with no prices in the served HTML; Grubhub's own listing for the same store is also a client-rendered shell with no prices, so DoorDash was the only priced source. Deduped by name+price; Most Ordered carousel kept because its items (e.g. Whiskey River BBQ burger, Royal Red Robin) do not recur under Burgers. Divisor sweep 1.00-1.35 found no cluster >60%; cent endings are the restaurant's normal 9-ending scheme (.19/.39/.59/.79/.99), so no markup subtracted. Sections read: Most Ordered, Limited Time, New Items, Burgers, Donatos Pizza, Wraps & Sandwiches, Entrees, Salads, Chicken Wings, Veggie & More, Appetizers. Did not reach a desserts/kids/beverage section if one exists; core burger/entree/salad offering is fully priced.
